context: NGO Cultural Website / Theatre Page Editorial Redesign

typography.mono_font: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

visual_enhancers.hover_state: Subtle border-color transition to #111111, image micro-zoom scale(1.02)
visual_enhancers.shadows: Flat non-gradient subtle ambient crisp edges
visual_enhancers.framing: Clean 1px stroke around photography cards without heavy elevation

hero_photo.alt: Joyful Dance on a Warm Theater Stage (Women in white costumes performing)

grids_and_layouts.hero_grid: 2-column split (Text 5fr, Hero Photo 7fr) on desktop (>=1024px); 1-column on mobile (<1024px)
grids_and_layouts.text_cols_split: Left header sticky/static 5fr, Right prose content 7fr; gap: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 4.5rem)
grids_and_layouts.past_productions_split: 5fr left text / 7fr right photo with structured caption & action links

breakpoint_320.hero_layout: Single column vertical stack, image ratio 4/3

breakpoint_768.hero_layout: Single column vertical stack with centered photo container

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure exact copy and layout matching reference screenshot for /our-work/theatre page.
Preserve all existing shared links, header navigation dropdowns, footer links, and CMS LiveEditor capabilities.
Use the provided white-costume photo URL for the Theatre Hero section.
Use the provided red/green/grey-costume photo URL for the Past Productions/Performances section.
Do NOT generate or substitute external placeholder images — use the exact asset URLs provided.
All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, photo wrappers, card headers) MUST include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="theatre-hero-cta-button").
Maintain strict typography: Headings in Cormorant, Body text in Public Sans, High-contrast monochrome palette (#111111 on #FFFFFF).
Respect responsive breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px, 1920px) without image clipping or text truncation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, AI-slop layouts: maintain crisp 1px borders, high-contrast monochrome design, and generous editorial line-height.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers, popovers, or dropdown menus — use solid #FFFFFF with #E6E6E6 borders.
Avoid universal transitions (e.g. transition: all). Specify explicit properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease.
Never use raw emoji characters as functional icons.
Include data-testid on every button, link, CMS block wrapper, and interactive image component.
